name: s2mgrs
title: Sentinel-2 tiling grid (MGRS 100 km squares, 109.8 km footprints)
description: UTM north and south zones; tiles are MGRS 100 km squares, each produced as a 109.8 km footprint snapped to the 60 m pixel lattice, so neighbours overlap by 9.8 km. IDs are MGRS codes.

list.origin: ESA Sentinel-2 tiling grid (KML), as tabulated in starc

provenance.source: ESA Sentinel-2 tiling grid; footprint rule verified against real L2A items
provenance.derived_from: aatgrid R/mgrs.R (rule verified exact on 132 codes) and the starc store, re-checked here by tools/fixtures-s2mgrs.R
notes: Canonical IDs leave single-digit zones unpadded (8CMC), as in the ESA list and the archive's tile field; standard MGRS (GeographicLib) pads (08CMC). Both, and the T-prefixed product form (T8CMC), parse.

The footprint is not the 100 km square padded 4900 m on every side (as starc's R/aatgrid-mgrs.R comment says): the upper-left corner is the square's west/north edge snapped outward to the 60 m lattice, and the tile extends 109800 m east and south. All three band resolutions share that extent.
The 60 m snap lattice is anchored at the equator, so in southern zones northings are 40 mod 60 (1e7 % 60 = 40); this is why aatgrid's 60 m pixels are offset by 20 m.
Latitude bands C-X span 80S-84N; the polar caps (UPS) are not part of the Sentinel-2 grid.
